md-1: The lip is sweet, the face is sweet, the eye is sweet, the laugh is sweet, the heart is sweet, the walk is sweet — all of the Lord of sweetness is sweet.
md-2: Speech, life-story, garment, the turn of the waist, the step, the wander — all of the Lord of sweetness is sweet.
md-3: The flute is sweet, the dust is sweet, the hand is sweet, both feet are sweet, the dance is sweet, the friendship is sweet.
md-4: The song is sweet, the yellow cloth is sweet, the meal is sweet, sleep is sweet, the form is sweet, the tilaka is sweet.
md-5: Doing, crossing, taking, delighting, the play of the mouth, the stilling — all is sweet.
md-6: The gunja-bead is sweet, the garland is sweet, Yamuna is sweet, her wave is sweet, the water is sweet, the lotus is sweet.
md-7: The gopi is sweet, the play is sweet, union is sweet, freedom is sweet, the seen is sweet, the cultured is sweet.
md-8: The cowherds are sweet, the cows are sweet, the staff is sweet, creation is sweet, the crushed is sweet, the fruit is sweet — all of the Lord of sweetness is sweet.
